name: gamenet_handle_pkt08_player_kill_event
description: GameNet::HandlePkt08_PlayerKillEvent resolves killer and victim rows, emits the kill-feed message, and on the host updates victim score and broadcasts a scoreboard snapshot.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the GameNet packet cluster; Binary Ninja notes a partial-register HLIL merge around the packet pointer and kill-entry id that is resolved by assembly review.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x433060 validates resolving killer and victim rows, returning 0 for missing rows, reading packet->killMethodOrOptCatalogEntryId before optional OptCatalog::FindEntryById, calling GameNet::ShowPlayerKillMessage, host-only score update, suicide score decrement clamped to zero, non-suicide increment, SendPkt09_PlayerScoreboardSnapshot, and return value 1 on handled packets.

The native packet-08 smoke verifies non-host handling, missing-row rejection, host scoring, suicide clamping, kill-entry lookup, local HUD kill message behavior, and scoreboard snapshot send behavior.
